all.text: At this latitude, the Earth's spin carries the ship east at about 700 mph, whatever the captain is doing.
The sun reaches its highest point here about 19 minutes after it does in Southampton.
Drill straight through the Earth from here and you'd surface at 47.9°S, 173.9°E, about 340 km from Dunedin.
This far north, they're roughly level with Seattle, even though it's a world away.
The seabed is roughly 140 m below the ship.
